observations.behavior: Clarified the purpose of TAKEOVER_MAX_HOLD_SECONDS and its role in preventing a terminal-workflow holder from blocking takeover indefinitely.
observations.code_quote: # A live loader past this hold still keeps the lock, because taking over lets the new run's
observations.posthog_connection: This constant acts as a backstop against a staleness heuristic being fooled, allowing a takeover when a holder has held the lock too long despite not being stale.

observations.behavior: Refactored the takeover decision logic: removed the explicit 'all-terminal' and 'max hold exceeded' checks from the condition, and separated the stale/non-stale and hold-time checks.
observations.posthog_connection: This allows the system to distinguish between a holder that is actively progressing and one that is stale, regardless of the hold time, and then apply the hold-time check separately.

observations.behavior: Changed the reason logged when a takeover is skipped due to an active consumer, and added the holder job ID to the log.
observations.posthog_connection: This provides better observability into why a takeover was skipped, distinguishing between an active consumer and a holder that exceeded the max hold time.
